title: Borel dimension growth and hyperfiniteness
summary: We show that every increasing union of Borel graphs of pointwise volume growth at most $\exp(O(r^γ))$ is hyperfinite, where $γ\approx 0.1523$ is the unique real root of $(1 - γ)^3 - 4γ= 0$. This implies a positive answer to the special case of Weiss's question on the hyperfiniteness of Borel actions of countable amenable groups, for countable amenable groups locally of volume growth $\exp(O(r^γ))$ for $γ$ as above.
